beats.en: Human taste has five sensations: sweet, salt, bitter, sour, and umami (savoury, like MSG). Texture and temperature also shape food acceptance.

textbookBox.concept: Sportspersons need high energy—primarily from carbohydrates—plus adequate hydration (cool water, coconut water, thin shakes). Excess protein supplements can strain kidneys and bones.

beats.en: Sportspersons need high energy—primarily from carbohydrates—plus adequate hydration (cool water, coconut water, thin shakes). Excess protein supplements can strain kidneys and bones.

beats.en: Food quality is certified by marks like FSSAI, AGMARK, and ISI. Spoilage is caused by microbial load and enzymes, and is slowed by heat, cold, drying, or preservatives.
